input: Prepare me for a meeting with Datadog (datadoghq.com)

challenges.evidence: Management said its largest customer had renewed but usage had declined, and that reduction was incorporated into Q3 and full-year guidance.
challenges.challenge: A major customer reduced usage despite renewing

challenges.evidence: Management said customers’ focus had shifted toward AI cost optimization and that customers were asking how to rein in fast-growing spend and determine whether they were achieving the right outcomes.
challenges.challenge: Customers are struggling to control the cost and outcomes of rapidly expanding AI usage

challenges.evidence: Datadog’s State of AI Engineering 2026 report found nearly 5% of AI model requests failing in production, with close to 60% of failures caused by capacity limits.
challenges.challenge: Operational complexity and capacity limits are blocking reliable AI in production

key_people.name: Olivier Pomel
key_people.title: CEO & Co-Founder
key_people.recent: On November 4, he said Datadog was seeing strong platform adoption as customers scale digital operations and AI, and that the company was developing specialized AI models to help manage complexity and move toward autonomous operations.

key_people.name: Yanbing Li
key_people.title: Chief Product Officer
key_people.recent: On October 29, she tied Datadog’s Forrester recognition to its shift toward autonomous operations and said the unified platform covers observability, security and AI workloads; she also cited more than 10,000 paying Bits AI customers.

key_people.name: David Obstler
key_people.title: Chief Financial Officer
key_people.recent: In the Q2 earnings call, he said the largest customer’s usage reduction was reflected in Q3 and full-year guidance, despite that customer’s renewal.

key_people.name: Alexis Lê-Quôc
key_people.title: CTO & Co-Founder
key_people.recent: Datadog’s leadership page identifies him as CTO and co-founder, with a background centered on infrastructure, operations and operational efficiency—relevant to the company’s autonomous-operations agenda.

priorities.evidence: Datadog says Bits AI detects, investigates and remediates while engineers remain in control; Bits AI had surpassed 10,000 paying customers.
priorities.priority: Move from observability toward autonomous operations with Bits AI

priorities.evidence: Datadog introduced Scout 1.0, its first AI model specialized for investigating production issues, to power Bits Investigation at much lower inference cost and enable earlier, more frequent investigations.
priorities.priority: Build and commercialize specialized AI models for production operations

priorities.evidence: Q2 product expansion covered the DevOps loop, development loop, and end-to-end AI-stack observability, security and optimization, including Data Observability, Agent Console, Agent Observability and Bits Evals.
priorities.priority: Expand the unified platform across observability, security and AI workloads

priorities.evidence: Code Execution became generally available in the MCP Server; Datadog reported 73% fewer input tokens, 90% answer accuracy versus 74%, and 40% fewer tool calls in its evaluation.
priorities.priority: Make AI-agent operations more efficient, accurate and governed

priorities.evidence: Q3 revenue grew 35% year over year to $1.20 billion; Datadog had about 4,860 customers with at least $100,000 ARR, up 20% year over year.
priorities.priority: Scale AI and enterprise growth while deepening platform adoption

what_they_do.value: Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale.

recent_changes.summary: Q3 revenue reached $1.20 billion, up 35% year over year; Scout 1.0 was introduced as Datadog’s first specialized model and powers Bits Investigation in preview.
recent_changes.headline: Datadog reported Q3 2026 results and launched Scout 1.0

recent_changes.summary: Datadog received the highest possible scores in eleven criteria, including Innovation, Roadmap, ModelOps and AI Governance; Yanbing Li framed the strategy as a shift toward agentic operations.
recent_changes.headline: Named a Leader in Forrester’s AIOps Platforms research

recent_changes.summary: The release lets AI agents query Datadog in a managed sandbox, with Datadog reporting lower token use, fewer tool calls and higher answer accuracy in evaluations.
recent_changes.headline: Code Execution became generally available in Datadog MCP Server

recent_changes.summary: Scout is a specialized SRE investigation model designed to reduce inference cost and extend Bits from first responder toward more autonomous incident resolution; it was in closed preview.
recent_changes.headline: Introduced Scout 1.0

talking_points: Which AI workloads or agent workflows are creating the most urgent cost, capacity or reliability problems, and how are you measuring ROI today?
As Datadog moves from detecting issues to autonomous investigation and remediation, where do you need stronger guardrails, governance or human approval?
With Scout, MCP Code Execution and the broader unified platform expanding, which teams or workflows are the next priority for adoption—and what would make expansion commercially compelling?
